— 🇮🇷 NEW: Iran’s Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, issued a message on the occasion of Holy Defense Week and the martyrdom anniversary of Sayyed Hassan Nasrallah
In the message, the following important points were mentioned:
– The days when Western powers controlled Iran and imposed their will upon the Iranian nation are long gone; the Islamic Revolution has awakened the people’s spirits, and I assure the people those dark days will never be repeated.
– Controlling the Strait of Hormuz is a joint desire of the entire Iranian nation, despite the differences between some segments in society.
– Throughout the past few wars, starting with the first imposed war [Saddam’s invasion], Iran has risen from the ashes of war like a burning Phoenix, and has become so powerful that it now casts its shadow on the enemy’s lands. 
– Since the time of the Prophets, no greater figure than Sayyed Hassan Nasrallah has appeared in the land of Al-Sham [the Levant], and with his stature, wisdom and courageous actions he turned Lebanon into a jewel of the Resistance and brought it to a position of greatness.
– Some people these days consider Iran to be the 4th world superpower, but that is according to worldly calculations; when God is entered into the equation, Iran is a divine power, second to none.
– In some important areas of bravery and presence in the fields, women have outpaced men.
– Today, the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz have been emptied of American military presence, and their navy does not dare to advance beyond the Arabian Sea; God Willing, they will sooner or later be expelled from the Arabian Sea as well.

events.text:
🇬🇧 HMS Agamemnon, the Royal Navy's newest hunter-killer submarine, has sailed from Barrow-in-Furness for the first time to begin sea trials.
The sixth of seven Astute-class nuclear-powered attack submarines (SSNs), HMS Agamemnon left BAE Systems' shipyard on September 25, 2026, marking a major step toward frontline service with the Royal Navy at HM Naval Base Clyde.
The 97-metre, 7,400-tonne submarine is the largest and most advanced attack submarine ever operated by the Royal Navy. Powered by a Rolls-Royce nuclear reactor, it will never need refuelling during its service life. Its high-tech capabilities include stealthy precision strike, anti-submarine warfare, and intelligence gathering.
HMS Agamemnon is armed with Tomahawk IV land-attack missiles capable of striking targets more than 1,000 miles away, alongside Spearfish heavyweight torpedoes. Its mission will be to safeguard the submarines carrying Britain's nuclear deterrent from adversary interference, as well as to project power by attacking land targets, engaging hostile submarines and warships, and supporting Royal Marines raids.

🔥⚔️ New strikes in Kiev renew questions over Ukraine’s gaps in air defense
Kiev’s air defenses were questioned by Ukrainian MP Oleksiy Goncharenko after a drone struck the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine in the city center.
He cited shortages of Patriot missiles and criticized the failure to intercept what he described as an ordinary Shahed-type drone, arguing that Kiev should focus on air defense rather than retaliatory strikes. He also claimed that the skies over the capital are effectively under Russian control and warned that the situation raises concerns ahead of winter.
Mayor Vitali Klitschko also reported a hit on a seven-story administrative building, while the Dobrobut medical center was damaged and caught fire.
What was hit in Kiev:
🌏 A building near Ukraine’s Constitutional Court
🌏 A seven-story administrative building 
🌏 The Dobrobut medical center, which was heavily damaged and caught fire
Separately, authorities in Brovary in the Kiev region reported elevated ammonia levels near a warehouse hit in a strike and advised residents to keep windows closed and limit time outdoors.
